note.en: Her signature offers all the right stats. Its CRIT Rate bonus makes up for the DEF% main stat, and it gives Electric DMG and Electric Sharp DMG, a distinct multiplier that sees little saturation. Its buff is easy to maintain. S5 is about 115%.
About 82%. The Battle Pass W-Engine edges ahead of the craftable alternative when maxed. Its CRIT Rate main stat helps her reach the 200% cap and its buff is unconditional, but DMG% bonuses saturate.

About 80% at S5 (about 76% at S1). The craftable W-Engine. It purely buffs DEF%, which does saturate it, and the lack of CRIT Rate makes her harder to build, but DEF% is valuable enough that it nearly matches the Battle Pass option.
About 75% at S1. A free W-Engine from the Spooky Funhouse Tales event. It gives CRIT Rate after an EX Special Attack and extra damage against enemies below 50% HP.
